title: Zephyr: epoch persistence
description: Epoch persistence in Zephyr. DONE - epoch_persist.c
notes:
2026-08-27 leaf audit found the existing DONE implementation is not spec-compliant. spec/02-physical-link.md section 4.4 and test/vectors/epoch_rollover.json require ordinary unsigned ordering, forbid 255-to-0 wrap, require cold boot 128..255, and require fail-closed behavior when freshness cannot be established. epoch_persist.c instead explicitly permits 255-to-0, treats missing/corrupt/read-failed state as persisted zero then chooses epoch 1, ignores settings_load_subtree errors, mutates s_boot_epoch and s_advanced before confirming the save, and returns an epoch even when persistence fails. Its uint8_t lichen_link_epoch_advance_for_boot(void) API cannot propagate read/write/corruption/exhaustion errors; l2/lichen_l2_init.c also ignores lichen_link_set_epoch return. Focused tests encode the obsolete wrap behavior and have no torn/corrupt/failure cases. A correct bounded repair requires an error-returning API plus changes to link_ctx.h and l2/lichen_l2_init.c, beyond the assigned clean target set of epoch_persist.c and persistence tests. No files modified; claim released for broader coordinated repair.
Replaced raw one-byte epoch storage with an exact 8-byte magic/version/epoch/inverse/checksum record and strict length/read/integrity validation. Boot API now accepts the link_init random [128,255] fallback plus output pointer and returns exact init/load/corruption/save/exhaustion errors; missing storage persists the random fallback, persisted 255 fails -EOVERFLOW, and cached state/output publish only after save success. Persist API rejects zero and non-advancing rollback and mutates cache only after durable success. lichen_l2_init now propagates advance/set errors and cleans up fail-closed. lichen_link_next_tx propagates persistence errors, persists the next epoch before live mutation, and freezes at epoch=255/seq=65535 with nonce_exhausted after allocating the terminal tuple instead of wrapping either field. Preserved CSMA context changes. Added strict host settings fault-injection suite covering missing, valid, idempotent, corrupt, torn, short/failed read, init/load/save failure, retry after failed save, exhaustion, rollback, and zero rejection; UBSan link_epoch_host 1/1 passed. Updated link_ctx host wiring and terminal no-wrap test; strict link_ctx 1/1 passed. Existing Zephyr link_epoch tests updated to the error-returning API and forbidden-wrap semantics. JSON vector validation and git diff --check pass. Externally owned workstation was not used.
close_reason: Fail-closed epoch persistence, durable-before-live ordering, no-wrap exhaustion, propagated callers, and corruption/error host tests complete.
